params.message:
Event pages that hold up with what the owner types

- Lining figures site-wide: Cormorant's old-style figures made "30" read as "3o".
- Dates and times in Europe/Brussels: the build runs in UTC, so a 16:26 start showed as 15:26.
- Event titles: whitespace collapsed, hand-spaced letters joined, size steps down for long titles.
- Summary and long description hidden when they repeat the title.
- Event page: one serif voice for date and time, no script date, no arrow, no double rule.
- Event paths fall back to a slug from the title when the stored slug is unusable (".").
- Agenda and page content aligned with the header; opening hours sorted Monday first.
- Studio: short-title hint and warnings, 15-minute time step, warnings for a start that looks
  like the moment of entry or a date that differs from the one in the title, slug check,
  "Korte beschrijving" only for what the title does not say.

Portal: De agenda toont activiteiten nu juist, met het uur in Belgische tijd en ook bij lange titels; de Studio helpt bij het invullen.
